newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 643 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 643 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 643 contracts, compared with 396 contracts traded overnight Thursday, according to the CBOT.
There were 11 wheat, 230 corn, 277 soybean, 44 soymeal, nine soyoil, 37 corn calls, 10 soybean calls and 25 wheat puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was one to 1-1/2 cents higher, corn 1-1/2 cents higher and soybeans 1-1/4 to 1-3/4 cents higher.
